system.message:

function Test-Caller {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)]
        [System.Management.Automation.CallStackFrame[]]
        $CallStack
    )
    $caller = $CallStack[1]
    $location = $caller.Location
    Write-Verbose -Message $('caller: ' + $location) -Verbose
    if ($location -eq '<No file>') {
        throw 'Invoke-Expression cannot be used in a script'
    }
}

function Invoke-Expression {
    [CmdletBinding(HelpUri='https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=2097030')]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0, ValueFromPipeline=$true)]
    [string]
    ${Command})

begin
{
    try {
        Test-Caller -CallStack (Get-PSCallStack)
        $outBuffer = $null
        if ($PSBoundParameters.TryGetValue('OutBuffer', [ref]$outBuffer))
        {
            $PSBoundParameters['OutBuffer'] = 1
        }

        $wrappedCmd = $ExecutionContext.InvokeCommand.GetCommand('Microsoft.PowerShell.Utility\Invoke-Expression', [System.Management.Automation.CommandTypes]::Cmdlet)
        $scriptCmd = {& $wrappedCmd @PSBoundParameters }

        $steppablePipeline = $scriptCmd.GetSteppablePipeline($myInvocation.CommandOrigin)
        $steppablePipeline.Begin($PSCmdlet)
    } catch {
        throw
    }
}

process
{
    try {
        $steppablePipeline.Process($_)
    } catch {
        throw
    }
}

end
{
    try {
        $steppablePipeline.End()
    } catch {
        throw
    }
}
}

rule.description: Powershell executing process discovery

system.message:
"Creating Scriptblock text (1 of 1):
#requires -RunAsAdministrator
# ==================================================================
# Benign traffic generator - WIN-CL1   (~1 hour)
# Mixed: realistic user activity + service/daemon background.
# NO attacks, NO net-use brute force, NO reg save SAM, NO log clears,
# NO artifact create/delete. Legitimate normal-host activity only.
#
# RUN AS (elevated pwsh):
#   .\benign_win.ps1 *>&1 | Tee-Object C:\atomic\benign_markers_win.txt
# ==================================================================

$Duration = 3600
$End = (Get-Date).AddSeconds($Duration)

function Log($m){ Write-Output ">>> $((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ')) $m" }
function Jitter(){ Start-Sleep -Seconds (Get-Random -Min 5 -Max 25) }

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path C:\atomic | Out-Null
Log "BENIGN_START duration=${Duration}s"

$sites = @("http://127.0.0.1/","http://example.com","http://127.0.0.1/index.html")
$words = @("report","meeting","budget","schedule","notes","summary","draft","review")

$round = 0
while ((Get-Date) -lt $End) {
    $round++
    Log "CYCLE $round"

    # ---------- USER ACTIVITY ----------
    # 1. web browsing (normal requests)
    foreach ($i in 1..(Get-Random -Min 3 -Max 7)) {
        try { Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($sites | Get-Random) -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5 | Out-Null } catch {}
        Start-Sleep -Seconds (Get-Random -Min 1 -Max 3)
    }

    # 2. file work in the user's Documents (create / edit / read normal docs)
    $dir = "$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\work_$((Get-Date).ToString('HHmmss'))"
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null
    $w = $words | Get-Random
    "draft $w $(Get-Date)" | Out-File "$dir\$w.txt"
    "more notes" | Add-Content "$dir\$w.txt"
    Get-Content "$dir\$w.txt" | Out-Null
    Copy-Item "$dir\$w.txt" "$dir\${w}_copy.txt"
    Get-ChildItem $dir | Out-Null
    Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $dir            # cleaning your OWN docs is normal

    # 3. normal shell / system usage (read-only)
    Get-Process | Out-Null
    Get-Service | Select-Object -First 20 | Out-Null
    Get-ChildItem C:\Users\Public | Out-Null
    whoami | Out-Null
    Get-Date | Out-Null

    # 4. a legitimate interactive-style logon (runas the same user, SUCCEEDS)
    #    normal successful logon events, not brute force
    try { Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList "/c echo hi & exit" -WindowStyle Hidden -Wait } catch {}

    Jitter

    # ---------- SERVICE / BACKGROUND ----------
    # 5. service health checks (normal monitoring)
    Get-Service Sysmon*, WinDefend, Wazuh* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null

    # 6. read event logs (normal; NOT clearing)
    Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 10 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null

    # 7. periodic update check (normal maintenance, read-only)
    if ($round % 8 -eq 0) {
        Log "update_check"
        try { Get-HotFix | Select-Object -First 5 | Out-Null } catch {}
    }

    # 8. heartbeat file in a normal app path (non-sensitive)
    "heartbeat $(Get-Date)" | Add-Content C:\atomic\app_heartbeat.log

    Jitter
}

Remove-Item C:\atomic\app_heartbeat.log -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Log "BENIGN_END"
Write-Output "# Done. On SOC-Wazuh extract WIN-CL1's agent for this window:"
Write-Output "#   ./extract_agent.sh <WIN-CL1-ID> <START-UTC> <END-UTC> benign_win"

ScriptBlock ID: 11cf50a5-2cb7-4140-95ab-23ec696b6d0a
Path: C:\atomic\benign_win.ps1"
